data: What’s the shape of the line in Figure 11?

The line in Figure 11 is a smooth curve that starts at approximately 1.75 on the y-axis and decreases gradually as the x-axis increases. The curve appears to be concave downward, meaning it curves downward as it moves to the right. The line reaches a plateau around the 0.75 mark on the y-axis after approximately 6000 batches. The line is colored blue.
